verdict: M1497's sole testbench delta and corrected active-next oracle are sound, and the clean-result regular-file isolation works. The release gate nevertheless fails: 22 of 48 independent checks are false negatives. The source checker accepts ten resealed contract mutations, the runtime validator does not exact-read the frozen RTL/SVA/witness/tool corpus, the success path accepts PASS tokens alongside missing coverage or an assertion Error line, and a post-attempt pre-try failure leaves no sealed quarantine. M1499 release authoring is forbidden.

baseline.sole_tb_delta: PASS: exactly one old oracle fragment is replaced
baseline.active_next_oracle: PASS: weight_accepted=0, psum_accepted=!request_first_q, public/latched first and source equality, stale-source rejection, X/Z fail-closed
baseline.clean_result: PASS: raw build is separate; four clean members are regular; symlink attack rejected

root_causes.contract: check_source validates status, claim boundary, vcs_compiles==0, TB delta and filelist shape, but not exact top-level/nested sets or most identity, oracle, result-hygiene, future-authority and authorization values.
root_causes.frozen_inputs: validate_authority exact-pins the M1459 runner source but never invokes its validate_authorities and never iterates P.BASE.EXACT. Pinning predecessor Python bytes does not pin the foundry model, parent/M935/wrapper RTL, R3 SVA, R15 witness, VCS binary, checker or tests actually used later.
root_causes.success_log: M1497 checks only one exact R13 and one exact R15 PASS token. Unlike M1459, it does not require phase/coverage/witness-operand records and does not reject Error/Fatal/Assertion/$error/$fatal lines.
root_causes.failure_path: The canonical attempt is published before RAW_BUILD.mkdir, but the guarded try/except begins after RAW_BUILD creation. A race/collision at RAW_BUILD therefore consumes the attempt without producing the required recursively sealed quarantine.

minimum_additive_successor: Make the checker require exact contract top-level and nested key sets and all values, including identity, oracle, result hygiene, future one-shot limits and every authorization field.
Before any attempt, exact-read all P.BASE.EXACT members plus the M1497 checker/tests and compare the contract/author bindings to live SHA-256 values; preserve the exact R13/TB/filelist gates.
Restore M1459's exact phase, coverage and witness-operand cardinality gates and Error/Fatal/Assertion/$error/$fatal rejection in addition to the two PASS tokens.
Move all operations after canonical attempt publication under the failure guard, or create RAW_BUILD before consuming the attempt; prove every post-attempt failure produces one sealed quarantine.
Add one regression for each M1498 false negative, then request a fresh different-author blind hammer.
